subject: Furniture around fireplaces and alcoves
hook: Alcove units made for the walls you actually have.
gbp:
Alcoves either side of a chimney breast are some of the most useful space in an older home, and some of the hardest to furnish. They're rarely the same size, rarely square, and often have sockets, skirting and picture rails to work around.

SUPERIO designs and builds made-to-measure alcove units for living rooms, dining rooms and bedrooms in Leek and across the Staffordshire Moorlands and Stoke-on-Trent. Options include closed base cupboards, open or enclosed shelving above, TV and media storage, and matching pieces across both alcoves even when the spaces differ.

What's included: a free, no-obligation design consultation; a full survey of each alcove and an itemised quote with no hidden costs; manufacture in our own workshop in Hanley, quality-checked before it leaves; and installation by our own team, with units scribed to follow your walls. If your fireplace is in use, we'll ask about it at the survey so the design respects its clearances.

Tap Learn more to see the furniture we make.
